use-product-specifications-tip: Start the product specification function, which is used to add different specifications of the product
use-stock-warning-tip: When inventory warning is enabled, the inventory of goods will be statistically managed
commodity-stock-less-than-zero-prohibite: Commodity Stock less than 0 prohibited for sale
commodity-stock-less-than-zero-tip: When the Stock of the product displayed in the system is less than 0, is it prohibited to sell it?
temporary-repricing-tip: Provide the function of temporarily changing the price on the QR code sales page
delete-cancel-order-tip: Controls whether you want to automatically delete Cancel orders every day
validity-time-tip: Set the validity period of the pending order, and automatically cancel the pending order when it expires
daily-settlement-tip: Set the daily settlement time of the store, and generate the daily settlement report data at the specified time
automatic-review-tip: If the automatic review of accounting notes is enabled, the accounting notes will be automatically approved when the amount value is lower than the set value
quick-tag-del-tips: This tag also contains a lot of content. If you want to delete all the content in this group, are you sure you want to delete them?
